items.stem: Why give an endpoint a name with WithName and use link generation instead of hard-coding paths?

options.text: Named endpoints let you generate URLs without hard-coding, so paths can change safely
options.rationale: Correct: link generation from names avoids brittle hard-coded paths.

options.text: Because unnamed endpoints cannot be called
Because names remove the need for route parameters
options.rationale: Parameters are separate from endpoint names.

items.stem: Which TWO are good practices for minimal API results? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Return TypedResults.Created with a location for a successful create
options.rationale: Correct: a 201 with a location is the correct created response.

options.text: Return a not-found result when the resource does not exist
options.rationale: Correct: status codes should reflect the actual outcome.

options.text: Return 200 OK for every response including errors
options.rationale: Uniform 200s hide real outcomes from clients.
Correct status codes are part of a usable API.

items.explanation: Correct: a 201 with a location is the correct created response.

items.stem: What does the route template /todos/{id:int} do?

options.text: Matches only when the id segment parses as an integer
options.rationale: Correct: the :int constraint restricts matching to integer values.

options.text: Matches any value for id including text
Binds id as a string always
options.rationale: The constraint binds and validates it as an int.

items.explanation: Correct: the :int constraint restricts matching to integer values.
